segments.description: An animated young man in a yellow hoodie is in a garden looking at a mysterious flower, taking a picture with his phone to search.
A live-action presenter in a yellow hoodie demonstrates using Google Lens on his phone, interacting with floating search UI graphics.
Animated scenes showing how Google Lens can be used on books, shoes in a market, and school setups.

hook.opening_visual: Animated man looking at a glowing exotic flower in a garden.
hook.opening_line: কোনো গাছ জিনিস বা পণ্যের নাম জানেন না?
hook.notes: The video starts by posing a relatable problem about identifying unknown items using visual search.
